description: Exact-name rule: `<noscript>` and a hyphenated custom element `<style-x>` are not refused, top-level or lifted.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 1 (g-boot-body-top-lift-render-s478, option (b)) — migrated: a body-top `${ … }` renders nothing (§17.3 amended S478)
rationale: §4.17 companion considerations: "`<script>` and `<style>` are NOT raw-content in scrml because scrml does not admit those elements at all." S462 amendment: the element is rejected with the same codes at EVERY position markup is parsed or built, decided on the parsed element, never on text. (S478 open-Qs ruling item 1: the lifted elements moved from a body-top `${ lift … }`, which renders nothing there and is E-MARKUP-STATEMENT-NOT-RENDERED (§17.3 amended S478), into a `${ … lift … }` in a markup body — still a lifted position.)
